info.name: Soda Cloud REST Attributes Contracts API

description.content:
The Soda Cloud REST API enables programmatic access to trigger data quality scans, retrieve check results, update incident status, manage datasets, datasources, contracts, runners, secrets, notification rules, and integrate data quality workflows into CI/CD pipelines. Supports EU and US cloud regions.
